description: A React component named 'Teams' that manages team data, including creating, editing, deleting, and viewing team details. It integrates with various sub-components and APIs to handle team operations, filtering, permissions, and settings within a dashboard UI.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new team by collecting form data, processing permissions and settings, and making an API call to create the team. It updates the teams list upon success.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a team by setting the team to delete and opening a confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms and executes the deletion of a selected team via API call, then refreshes the teams list.

methods.name: fetchUserModels
methods.description: Fetches the models available to the user to populate model selection options.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the teams list by updating the 'lastRefreshed' timestamp.

methods.name: handleFilterChange
methods.description: Updates filter criteria and fetches teams based on new filters.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Updates sorting criteria and fetches teams accordingly.

methods.name: handleFilterReset
methods.description: Resets filters to default values and reloads the team list.
